table.name: frpm
table.purpose: California Free or Reduced-Price Meals (FRPM) eligibility data per school for the 2014-2015 academic year: enrollment, free-meal counts and percentages, and FRPM (free + reduced-price) counts and percentages, along with school/district identifiers and charter status. One row per school (or district office / non-school location).

col_001.name: school_id_composite
col_001.description: Composite 14-digit CDE identifier: county code (2) + district code (5) + school code (7), e.g. 09-61853-0934554. Primary key, unique per row.

col_002.name: academic_year
col_002.description: Academic year of the data; constant '2014-2015' in this table.

col_003.name: county_code
col_003.description: Two-digit California county code (e.g. 19 = Los Angeles, 37 = San Diego, 30 = Orange).

col_004.name: district_code
col_004.description: Five-digit CDE district (LEA) code, e.g. 64733 = Los Angeles Unified.

col_005.name: school_code
col_005.description: Seven-digit CDE school code; '0000000' for district offices / non-school locations.

col_006.name: county_name
col_006.description: Name of the California county (matches county_code).

col_007.name: district_name
col_007.description: Name of the district / LEA (matches district_code).

col_008.name: school_name
col_008.description: Name of the school or location (e.g. 'District Office', 'Lincoln Elementary').

col_009.name: district_type
col_009.description: Type of LEA: Unified School District, Elementary School District, High School District, County Office of Education, State Board of Education, Non-School Locations.

col_010.name: school_level_type
col_010.description: School level/type by grade span and program: Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Intermediate/Middle Schools, Continuation High Schools, Alternative Schools of Choice, etc.

col_011.name: school_type
col_011.description: Educational option type: Traditional, Continuation School, Alternative School of Choice, Community Day School, Special Education School, Juvenile Court School, etc.

col_012.name: nslp_provision_type
col_012.description: National School Lunch Program provision/alternative meal-counting method in effect: Provision 1/2/3, Breakfast Provision 2, CEP (Community Eligibility Provision), Multiple Provision Types. Null for most schools (no provision).

col_013.name: is_charter_school
col_013.description: Flag indicating the school is a charter school (1 = yes, 0 = no). ~12% are charters, consistent with the charter number/funding columns being populated only for those rows.

col_014.name: charter_school_number
col_014.description: State charter school number (4-digit, e.g. '00D2'); populated only for charter schools (~12% of rows).

col_015.name: charter_funding_type
col_015.description: Charter funding model: Directly funded or Locally funded (or 'Not in CS funding model'); populated only for charter schools.

col_017.name: lowest_grade
col_017.description: Lowest grade served: 'K' = kindergarten, 'P' = preschool/pre-K, otherwise numeric grade.

col_018.name: highest_grade
col_018.description: Highest grade served (1-12; 'K' and 13 also appear, 13 likely indicating ungraded/extended).

col_019.name: enrollment_current_year
col_019.description: Total enrollment (2014-15) used as the base for the first set of eligibility figures.

col_020.name: free_meals_count
col_020.description: Count of students eligible for free meals (first measure).

col_021.name: free_meals_percent
col_021.description: Share of enrollment eligible for free meals (col_020 / col_019), 0-1.

col_022.name: frpm_count
col_022.description: Count of students eligible for free OR reduced-price meals (first measure).

col_023.name: frpm_percent
col_023.description: Share of enrollment eligible for FRPM (col_022 / col_019), 0-1.

col_024.name: enrollment_second_measure
col_024.description: Second enrollment figure, slightly different from col_019; likely enrollment for a different base period (e.g. 2013-14 or an adjusted/unduplicated count) used for the second set of eligibility figures.

col_025.name: free_meals_count_second_measure
col_025.description: Second free-meals eligible count, paired with col_024 as base.

col_027.name: frpm_count_second_measure
col_027.description: Second FRPM (free + reduced-price) eligible count, paired with col_024 as base.

table.name: satscores
table.purpose: California school/district-level SAT exam results: enrollment of grade-12/graduates, test takers, and average SAT section scores (reading/critical reading, math, writing) plus number meeting benchmark, by school or district.

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: Primary key. 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code identifying the school (S rows) or district (D rows) the record reports on.

col_002.name: record_type
col_002.description: Reporting level: 'S' = school-level record (has school name), 'D' = district-level record (school name null).

col_003.name: school_name
col_003.description: School name; null for district-level (D) records.

col_005.name: county_name
col_005.description: California county name (Los Angeles, San Diego, ...).

col_006.name: enrollment_grade_12
col_006.description: Number of grade-12 students (enrollment) at the school/district; 0 to 43,324.

col_007.name: test_takers
col_007.description: Number of students who took the SAT; always <= col_006, 0 to 24,305.

col_008.name: avg_sat_reading
col_008.description: Average SAT reading/critical reading score (range ~308-653, plausible SAT section scale 200-800). Null when no test takers.

col_009.name: avg_sat_math
col_009.description: Average SAT math score (range ~289-699, SAT section scale). Null when no test takers.

col_010.name: avg_sat_writing
col_010.description: Average SAT writing score (range ~312-671, SAT section scale). Null when no test takers.

col_011.name: num_met_benchmark
col_011.description: Count of students meeting a SAT benchmark/eligibility threshold (0 to 5,837, <= test takers). Exact benchmark definition unresolved.

table.name: schools
table.purpose: California Department of Education school directory: one row per public school (or educational site) in California, with location, status, type, grade spans, and administrator contact information. Links to frpm and satscores via the CDS code (col_001).

col_001.name: cds_code
col_001.description: 14-digit CDS (County-District-School) code, unique identifier for each school; primary key. Joins to frpm/satscores.

col_002.name: district_code
col_002.description: 7-digit district (administrative agency) code within the CDS system; first two digits are the county code (all start with 06 = California FIPS county prefix range 600001-691137).

col_003.name: school_code
col_003.description: 5-digit school code within its district (last segment of the CDS code); null for district-level/COE rows.

col_004.name: status_type
col_004.description: School operational status: Active, Closed, Merged, or Pending.

col_005.name: county
col_005.description: County name in California (e.g., Los Angeles, Butte).

col_006.name: district
col_006.description: Name of the district or administrative agency the school belongs to (e.g., Los Angeles Unified, county offices of education).

col_008.name: street_address
col_008.description: Mailing/physical street address, spelled-out street suffixes.

col_009.name: street_address_abbrev
col_009.description: Same street address with abbreviated suffixes (St., Rd., etc.).

col_011.name: zip
col_011.description: ZIP code (5- or 9-digit) of the school's address.

col_013.name: mailing_street_address
col_013.description: Mailing street address (may differ from physical address; e.g., PO Boxes).

col_014.name: mailing_street_address_abbrev
col_014.description: Mailing street address with abbreviated suffixes.

col_016.name: mailing_zip
col_016.description: ZIP code of the mailing address.

col_017.name: mailing_state
col_017.description: State of the mailing address; always 'CA'.

col_019.name: nces_id
col_019.description: NCES federal school ID (mostly null); values like 2881, 153, 5000 are plausible NCES school codes, but exact meaning is uncertain.

col_021.name: open_date
col_021.description: Date the school opened; 1980-07-01 is a default/placeholder for older schools.

col_022.name: close_date
col_022.description: Date the school closed (null for active schools); 1989-06-30 is a common placeholder.

col_023.name: charter_school_flag
col_023.description: Boolean flag, 1 = charter school (~10% of rows, consistent with CA charter share).

col_024.name: charter_number
col_024.description: Charter school number, populated only for charter schools (null rate matches charter flag).

col_025.name: charter_funding_type
col_025.description: Charter funding model: Directly funded, Locally funded, or not in the charter school funding model.

col_026.name: district_type_code
col_026.description: Two-digit code for the type of administrative agency/district (54 = Unified, 52 = Elementary, 00 = COE, 56 = High School District); pairs with col_027.

col_027.name: district_type
col_027.description: Label of the administrative agency type (Unified School District, County Office of Education, etc.).

col_028.name: school_type_code
col_028.description: Two-digit code for the educational level/type of the school (60 = Elementary, 66 = High School, 62 = Middle); pairs with col_029.

col_029.name: school_type
col_029.description: Label of the school type (Elementary Schools (Public), High Schools (Public), Continuation High Schools, etc.).

col_030.name: education_option_code
col_030.description: Code for the educational option type (TRAD = Traditional, CON = Continuation, COMMDAY = Community Day, etc.); pairs with col_031.

col_031.name: education_option
col_031.description: Label of the educational option (Traditional, Continuation School, Juvenile Court School, etc.).

col_032.name: grade_span_code
col_032.description: Code for the grade category served (ELEM, HS, UG = ungraded, INTMIDJR, ELEMHIGH, A = adult, PS = preschool); pairs with col_033.

col_033.name: grade_category
col_033.description: Label of the grade category (Elementary, High School, Ungraded, etc.).

col_035.name: low_high_grade_range_2
col_035.description: Second/alternative grade span served (e.g., schools with multiple tracks or updated spans); same format as col_034.

col_037.name: virtual_school_flag
col_037.description: Boolean flag, 1 for a small subset (~5%); plausibly indicates virtual/online school, but no direct evidence.

col_038.name: latitude
col_038.description: Latitude of the school (decimal degrees, ~32.5-44.2, consistent with California).

col_039.name: longitude
col_039.description: Longitude of the school (decimal degrees, negative, consistent with California).

col_040.name: administrator_first_name
col_040.description: First name of the school's administrator/principal.

col_041.name: administrator_last_name
col_041.description: Last name of the school's administrator/principal.

col_042.name: administrator_email
col_042.description: Email address of the school's administrator/principal.

col_043.name: contact_first_name
col_043.description: First name of a secondary contact (mostly null); likely a designated contact person.

col_044.name: contact_last_name
col_044.description: Last name of the secondary contact.

col_049.name: last_update_date
col_049.description: Date the record was last updated/verified in the directory (bulk dates like 2015-06-18 and 1999-06-24 suggest batch updates).
